text:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning a mosaic canary for model-serving v2.3 today 16:00 UTC. Percent ladder: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% over ~90m. Who's on smoke checks?
morgan: I'm primary on smoke. Can monitor latency and error budget. What's the rollback trigger?
tess: Rollback if p50 increases >100ms or errors >0.5% sustained for 5m. Also fail if any golden prompt returns unsafe/off-topic. Confirmed?
alex: Ack. Also need cohort selection — starting from internal beta (employee+alpha testers) then EU geo. @li can you confirm routing config and cohort tags?
li: Routing deck updated: cohort tag `mosaic-beta`. Region order: us-west -> eu-west. We'll keep burst capacity at 2x for first two stages.
ops-bot: deploy-scheduler: Canary scheduled by @alex for 2026-03-18T16:00:00Z. Stages: 0.5% (15m), 2% (30m), 10% (45m). Auto-fallback disabled per request.
morgan: Are we enabling KV-prefix caching on v2.3? Might shift baseline latency.
tess: Yes, caching enabled with conservative TTLs. Config snippet is in the runbook.
li: Smoke checklist (quick): health endpoints green, tail latency q95 < 350ms, error% < 0.5, 5 golden prompts pass. I'll run golden prompts at 16:05 and 16:40 and paste results here.
alex: Perfect. @tess you own canary rollback if triggers hit. @morgan you monitor and escalate to @eng-oncall if infra anomalies.
tess: Got it. Rollback command I have on hand:
```
./deploy rollback --env=hosted --tag=v2.2 --reason="canary regressed"
```
Will execute and notify if we need to abort. :thumbsup:
morgan: I'll post short summary after each stage (latency, errors, success rate). Ping me if you want extra metrics (token-level cost, cache hit-rate). :mag:
alex: Thanks team. If no blockers, I'll flip the scheduler in 20m and post the scheduler confirmation here.
tess: No blockers from my side.
li: Ready.
ops-bot: deploy-scheduler: Reminder scheduled in ~10m.
